role.altitude: The two accountants stop pulling data out of AFAS and checking samples by hand. They own the tie-outs, the control tests that run over every transaction, and the judgement calls on tax positions, findings and control design. Days to close and audit adjustments are the numbers they answer for.
reach: controller: month-close sign-off and the control framework, so accountants can propose and maintain controls themselves
bookkeeper: AP exception queue, so the rules that flag VAT-code and duplicate-invoice errors are fixed at the source
fpa: budget-against-actual commentary, reusing the same governed AFAS extract
people-analyst: AFAS role and authorisation data, shared for segregation-of-duties tests
skills_to_grow: Writing and maintaining rule-based tests (SQL or Python) on the AFAS extract
Reviewing model-drafted workpapers and findings for unstated assumptions
Dutch VAT on cross-border and agency flows, and readiness for e-invoicing from 2030
Running a structured process-owner interview and turning it into a control
role.ambitious_version: A continuous control monitor on the governed AFAS extract: every journal, supplier change, agency invoice and VAT line tested nightly, with exceptions routed to bookkeepers and a monthly findings report drafted for the controller. The accountants own the test library and write one new test per month from what they find, so the close is shorter and the external auditor finds fewer adjustments.

tasks.short: Compute VAT and corporate tax from AFAS, prepare and file returns, arrange payment.

steps.what: Extract VAT and tax accounts from AFAS and tie them to the ledger
Check odd lines: reverse charge, intra-EU, agency invoices with wrong VAT codes

loop.input: Invoice lines whose VAT code fails a rule, with the invoice PDF text
loop.output: Proposed VAT treatment with the invoice phrase that supports it
loop.check: Proposal must match a rule table (country, supplier VAT number, reverse-charge wording); mismatches go to the accountant
loop.stop: One pass per line, max 2 retries; unclear lines go to the manual queue
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules catch the wrong code, but reverse-charge and place-of-supply hints sit in free invoice text

steps.what: Prepare VAT return and corporate tax estimate in AFAS
Controller review, approval and filing with the Belastingdienst
Pay the assessment through Rabobank and book the payment

tasks.design: Use Jonas in AFAS Profit for the returns. Add a scheduled job on the nightly AFAS extract that ties VAT accounts to the ledger and runs VAT-code rules on every line. A small model loop reads the invoice text for flagged lines only. Payment batches are prepared automatically, and a person releases them in Rabobank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tie-outs were rebuilt in Excel each period. Agency and cross-border invoice text could not be read by rules, so every exception was checked by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS Jonas helps with income and corporate tax returns, and from 2026 also VAT. AI coding makes the tie-out and rule job a few days of work.
tasks.still_hard: Tax positions and corporate tax estimates stay human judgement. No benchmark covers Dutch VAT. The rules for domestic e-invoicing are not law yet.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding a tax position, signing off what is filed and dealing with the Belastingdienst stay with the accountant and the controller.

ambition.what: A monthly VAT position and corporate tax estimate instead of quarterly or year-end only, so the forecast carries a trusted tax line

tasks.altitude: The accountant reviews exceptions and estimates instead of compiling returns, and gains the right to change VAT rules in the test library.

reach.task: Coding supplier and agency invoices in AFAS
reach.learn: Which VAT-code errors start at entry, so a rule can block them at the source

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas helps with income and corporate tax returns from 2022 and VAT from 2026; the user stays responsible for the check
Tax estimates belong on the list of things a person must review
B2B e-invoicing is planned from 1 July 2030 but is not law yet
Rule checks on VAT codes against the supplier country and VAT number cover most exceptions

assumptions: Noordhaven files monthly or quarterly VAT returns from AFAS
AFAS is on Profit 8 or later, with Jonas switched on
Corporate tax is prepared in-house, with the external adviser reviewing
unknowns: Whether an external tax adviser files the corporate tax return
How many invoices per quarter are intra-EU or reverse-charge
Whether the Lefebvre Sdu content is licensed
research_questions: How many VAT exceptions per quarter today, and how many does a rule table explain without reading invoice text?
Does Jonas for VAT (OB) cover Noordhaven's agency and cross-border flows in Profit 8?
How many hours does the current Excel tie-out take each period?
Will the external auditor and tax adviser accept a script-based tie-out as a workpaper?

tasks.short: Write reports on internal audit and control-test findings for the controller and the external auditor.

steps.what: Collect test results, evidence and earlier findings
Judge severity, root cause and financial impact per finding
Write the findings report in Word

loop.input: Rated findings with linked evidence and amounts
loop.output: Report sections: condition, criterion, cause, effect, recommendation
loop.check: Every number and document reference in the text must match the evidence pack; a script compares them, and failures are flagged
loop.stop: Max 2 redrafts per section; then the section is left for the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: A template fills tables but cannot write clear cause and effect text per finding

steps.what: Discuss findings with process owners and agree actions
Track open actions and chase owners

tasks.design: Test results land in one findings register, a SharePoint list fed by the control tests. A bounded model step drafts each finding in the standard condition-criterion-cause-effect form, and a script checks every figure against the evidence. Open actions are chased by Power Automate reminders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence sat in scattered Excel files and mail. Writing clear findings text took a person's time, and no tool could do it reliably.
tasks.enabler_now: Models now draft structured text from given evidence well. Simple numeric checks catch invented or changed figures.
tasks.still_hard: Rating severity and naming the true root cause takes judgement. A draft that quietly adds an assumption cannot be traced back to the evidence [S6].
tasks.human_edge: Deciding what is a finding, how serious it is, and holding the conversation with the process owner stay with the accountant.

ambition.what: A short findings report after every month-end close, not only at year-end and the annual audit

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends report time on rating and discussing findings. The draft arrives already written and checked against the evidence.

reach.task: Year-end management letter response to the external auditor
reach.learn: How the auditor rates findings, so internal ratings match theirs

evidence.claim: Models beat licensed CPAs on detailed month-end scenarios, but the study leaves out client communication and tacit context
Judgement and multi-step reasoning errors are the main failure on accounting tasks
A model that adds an unnoticed assumption leaves a workpaper that cannot be rebuilt

assumptions: Findings follow a standard template stored on SharePoint
Most findings come from internal control tests and audit preparation, not a separate internal audit team
unknowns: How many findings reports are written per year, and who reads them
Whether the external auditor relies on internal findings
Which model service is approved under Noordhaven's AVG policy for confidential financial data
research_questions: How long does one findings report take today, split into collecting, writing and discussing?
Does the controller accept a model-drafted finding after review, and how much do they edit it?
How often does the draft contain a number or reference that fails the evidence check?

tasks.short: Review AFAS, interfaces and access rights, and recommend controls for reliable financial data.

steps.what: Export AFAS roles and user rights and check segregation of duties
Test data integrity: interface counts, duplicate suppliers, IBAN changes
Walk through processes with bookkeepers, payroll and HRIS
Judge control gaps and design new or changed controls
Write the control recommendation memo

loop.input: Control design notes and the exception counts behind them
loop.output: Memo with the risk, the proposed control, its owner and test
loop.check: Each claimed exception count matches the dashboard query; the accountant reads it before it is sent
loop.stop: One draft plus one redraft; then manual
loop.why_not_simpler: The memo is free text for managers; a template alone reads as a table dump

tasks.design: Build a nightly Python job on the governed AFAS extract. It runs segregation-of-duties checks on AFAS roles and integrity tests across AFAS, the agency portals and Rabobank CAMT.053 files. Results feed a Power BI control dashboard. Walkthroughs and control design stay with the accountant, and a bounded model step drafts the memo.
tasks.previous_blocker: Authorisation and master data were exported by hand once a year and compared in Excel. That made testing slow and partial.
tasks.enabler_now: The nightly AFAS extract already exists for Power BI. AI coding makes a library of fixed tests quick to build and change.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing which risks matter and designing controls people will actually follow. Log-based tests on user actions may count as monitoring staff, which needs works council consent under WOR art. 27.
tasks.human_edge: Weighing risk against how the warehouse sites and agency process really work, and convincing owners to change, stay with the accountant.

ambition.what: A standing nightly control dashboard for the controller and Finance Director, with SoD conflicts and supplier IBAN changes

tasks.altitude: The accountant moves from yearly exports to keeping a live test library. They gain the right to propose controls straight to the controller, backed by full-population data.

reach.task: Managing AFAS roles and HRIS authorisations
reach.learn: How roles are granted and changed, so SoD conflicts are blocked when a role is granted

evidence.claim: Deterministic tests over every transaction (duplicates, segregation of duties, IBAN changes) suit control work
Rabobank provides CAMT.053 statements that scripts can parse
Judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck on full accounting tasks

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract can include authorisation and supplier master change logs
An SoD matrix exists or can be agreed with the controller
unknowns: Whether the AFAS extract exposes role and mutation-log data
Whether the works council sees user-activity tests as staff monitoring
Who owns the governed data platform and the access to it
research_questions: How many SoD conflicts and IBAN changes without a second check show up in the first full run?
Can AFAS role and change-log data be extracted through the existing connector?
Does the works council need to give consent for tests that log individual users' actions?

tasks.short: Check samples of transactions against evidence, interview staff, and correct what was booked wrongly.

steps.what: Pick samples of journals, AP and payroll entries in AFAS
Match transactions to invoices, contracts, agency hours and bank lines

loop.input: Transactions with no exact key match and their candidate PDFs
loop.output: Proposed match with the amount, date and reference read from the document
loop.check: Amounts and dates must agree within set tolerances; anything else stays unmatched
loop.stop: Max 3 candidates per transaction; unmatched ones go to the accountant's queue
loop.why_not_simpler: Most matches are exact keys, but a few depend on references inside PDF invoices and contracts

steps.what: Interview bookkeepers, site admins and payroll on odd items
Record conclusions and exceptions in the workpaper
Book correcting entries for wrongly recorded items

tasks.design: Replace sampling with a monthly job that matches every journal, AP and agency transaction to bank lines, AFAS documents and agency portal hours. A bounded model step proposes matches only where references sit inside PDFs. The accountant gets a queue of unsupported items to discuss with staff. Correcting entries are prepared in AFAS and posted after the controller approves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching against PDFs and three agency portals by hand was too slow for the full population, so only samples were tested.
tasks.enabler_now: Exact-key matching is cheap to code. Models can now read invoice and contract references well enough to propose a match that a rule then checks.
tasks.still_hard: Payroll entries hold personal and sometimes special-category data under the AVG, so access must be tight. Agency portal exports differ by agency. Interviews stay slow.
tasks.human_edge: Asking the right questions of a site admin or bookkeeper and judging whether an explanation holds stay with the accountant.

ambition.what: Full-population matching of agency invoices to portal hours every month, instead of a yearly sample

tasks.altitude: The accountant's week moves from ticking samples to working an exception queue and interviewing. They decide which tolerances and rules count as supported.

reach.learn: Where hours and invoices drift apart, so a match rule can run before payment

evidence.claim: Accountants using AI closed 7.5 days faster across 79 firms, and 62% of those surveyed worry about errors
Workday's Accounting Agent prepares entries while the team stays responsible for review
A PDF is not an e-invoice, so matching against PDFs is needed until e-invoicing arrives

assumptions: Supplier invoices are stored in AFAS or SharePoint as PDFs linked to entries
All three staffing agency portals can export hours as files
unknowns: Whether the agency portals offer an API or only manual exports
How many transactions a month fail exact matching
Whether payroll data may be processed on the data platform under the current AVG register
research_questions: What share of AP and agency transactions match on exact keys alone?
How many unsupported items does a full-population run find compared with today's samples?
Will the external auditor rely on full-population matching and cut their own sample size?
Does the works council or privacy officer need to approve processing payroll entries in this job?
